# PRD Template

## Problem

Describe the user or business problem and why it matters now.

## Goals

List measurable outcomes this work should achieve.

## Non-goals

List nearby concerns that are intentionally out of scope.

## Users

Identify who uses or is affected by this change.

## Requirements

Describe user-facing requirements and acceptance criteria.

## Risks

List product, delivery, operational, and adoption risks.

## Open questions

Record unresolved questions and owners.
